#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.VeryAngry+Nun_NewOutfit.Mouth.Open
You: Not too good. To be honest, I was kinda beaten up by a bunch of guys and ended up in a hospital.
Shanice: What?! That’s terrible!
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.Normal+Nun_NewOutfit.Mouth.Open
Shanice: You should’ve called, I would visit you!
You: Well, as soon as I woke up they asked me to leave so…
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.Really+Nun_NewOutfit.Mouth.Open
Shanice: These scummy doctors need to find God. {{wi}}The hard way.
You: B-Better not!
She might actually do something stupid so let’s just change the topic. I don’t want to incite her.
